notes: Two branches meet at Hammam; Qatada, Abu al-Malih and his father are written once after them: the shared tail
«- المعنى -» and «- قال أبو الوليد -» are glosses: the second attaches «عن أبيه» to Abu al-Walid's wording; kept in the tail as the text writes it
Ibn Kathir's addition «فأجاز النبي عتقه» is content, left out
